subject: Delivery-based PO reconciliation and monthly statement — clarify net terms & headers
messages:
From: Susan Mallory <susan.mallory@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Greenfield Health Procurement <procurement@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO 5678 — delivery-triggered invoices / monthly settlement question

Hi Tessa,

Hope you're well. Our procurement team has reviewed the PO (attached GFH_PO_5678.pdf) and we have a couple of constraints from our ERP that will affect how we can pay Redwood:

- We require a separate PO line per delivery milestone with a matching invoice per line (GFH policy).
- Our AP process prefers a single monthly statement for reconciliation, but the ERP still needs invoice numbers tied to PO line items.
- Standard net term is Net 60 for our group, but we can request exceptions for strategic vendors.

Two asks: can Redwood issue (a) individual invoices per delivery (so they map to PO line items) and (b) a consolidated monthly statement that groups those invoices for payment? Also need to confirm the exact PO header fields Redwood needs so our buyer can issue subsequent POs in the same format.

Attached: GFH_PO_5678.pdf

Thank you — Susan

--
Susan Mallory
Head of Procurement
Greenfield Health
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Mallory <susan.mallory@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO 5678 — delivery-triggered invoices / monthly settlement question

Hi Susan — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the PO.

Short answers up front: yes, we can generate invoice per delivery and also provide a consolidated monthly statement. We'll need a few PO header fields to be present to guarantee ERP matching, and Vivek from Finance is looped to confirm the billing-side constraints.

Could you confirm the following fields on the PO exactly as they appear in your ERP?
- PO number (full string)
- Ship-to / Service location code (if any)
- Contract / SOW reference (optional but helps matching)
- BU/Cost-center string for GL mapping

Two commercial points to flag so procurement can set expectations:
1) Net terms: our standard for enterprise is Net 45 for delivery-based milestone billing; we can accept Net 60 if Greenfield provides an annual commitment or accepts a 1.5% surcharge to offset receivables risk.
2) Early-pay discount: we can offer 2% if invoices are paid within 15 days — this can be reflected as a separate line on the consolidated monthly statement.

I've attached our invoice template (redwood_invoice_template_v3.xlsx) to show the fields we populate. If that format works, we can map it directly to your ERP fields and avoid manual matching.

Next steps: once you confirm the exact PO header fields, we can draft a short payment addendum (single page) describing the monthly statement + per-delivery invoice workflow and the net-term option. Alternatively, we can sign a one-off exception for Net 60 for this PO.

Best,
Tessa
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_invoice_template_v3.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Susan Mallory <susan.mallory@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO 5678 — delivery-triggered invoices / monthly settlement question

Adding the finance perspective. A few clarifications from our AP side:

- We can produce an invoice per delivery (one invoice per milestone line) and a consolidated monthly statement referencing each invoice number for payment reconciliation.
- For the ERP matching to work reliably we need the PO number in the invoice header, the invoice number, and the PO line item ID (if available). If Greenfield cannot provide line IDs, a consistent description string per line is acceptable.
- Regarding Net terms: Net 45 is our baseline for milestone billing. If Greenfield must have Net 60, we typically require either a 1.5% surcharge or a tick that the vendor is approved for extended terms — given this is a strategic deal, we can do Net 60 for this PO but will require the purchase order to include a clause referencing RW deal id RW-2027-GFH-089 and an agreed credit holdback of 5% refundable on final acceptance.

I'll prepare the one-page payment addendum wording; Tessa, can you confirm whether Greenfield would accept the early-pay 2% discount option? If yes, we'll include both options.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Greenfield Health Procurement <procurement@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Susan Mallory <susan.mallory@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO 5678 — delivery-triggered invoices / monthly settlement question

Hi all — thanks for the quick responses. I’m the procurement analyst supporting this PO. A couple of notes:

- Our ERP will provide PO line item IDs when the buyer issues the PO; please ensure the buyer includes the line descriptions exactly as in the SOW so IDs match.
- Net 60 is our standard; I will escalate the Net 45 request but need internal approval.
- The 5% holdback is acceptable if it’s explicitly stated on the PO or in an attached addendum.

We prefer a consolidated monthly statement for payment runs (it reduces AP transactions). If Redwood includes invoice numbers and PO line references on the statement, our AP can auto-apply.

Can you draft the short payment addendum with both options (Net 45 standard; Net 60 + 1.5% surcharge; 2% 15-day early-pay discount)? We'll route the addendum to legal and request a one-time exception for the Net 45 path.

Regards,
Emily Chen
Procurement Analyst
Greenfield Health
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Greenfield Health Procurement <procurement@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 13:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO 5678 — delivery-triggered invoices / monthly settlement question

Emily / Susan — thanks. I've drafted the one-page payment addendum and uploaded it for signature: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/abc123

Highlights included in the addendum:
- We will issue individual invoices tied to each delivery milestone and a consolidated monthly statement listing all invoice numbers and amounts.
- Required PO header fields: PO number, PO line item IDs or exact line descriptions, service location code, buyer contact, GL/BU string (if provided).
- Commercial options: (A) Net 45 baseline; (B) Net 60 + 1.5% surcharge; (C) Net 60 with 2% early-pay 15-day discount if paid within 15 days of invoice.
- 5% holdback refundable on final acceptance unless otherwise stated on the PO.

Action requested: please review the addendum and sign via DocuSign if acceptable or propose edits. Once signed, we will confirm the invoice template mapping and finalize the PO header checklist so your buyers can issue future POs in the same format.

I'll leave the billing questions to Vivek to confirm the table used in the statement.

Thanks,
Tessa
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

I reviewed the addendum and routed it to legal; they want one minor edit to the holdback language to clarify release timing (30 days after final acceptance). Otherwise we’re good.
